name: AI Schema Gen – Schema Markup, Structured Data & Entity SEO for AI Search (JSON-LD)
author: AI Schema Gen

sections.description:
AI search engines — Google AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity — decide which brands to cite using entity signals. AI Schema Gen builds those signals automatically: entity-aware JSON-LD, sameAs links, @graph output with @id cross-references, and a Knowledge Graph Entity Score that tracks your progress.

Click Generate — the AI reads your content and creates accurate, entity-aware schema markup in seconds. No manual JSON-LD writing. No schema expertise required. Connects to the AI Schema Gen API using your free API key and handles everything automatically.

📖 Full Documentation at aischemagen.com/docs

Built for AI Search (GEO)

AI search doesn’t rank pages the way traditional search does — it decides which brands and sources to cite by reading entity signals: who you are, what you’re known for, and how your identity connects across the web. Schema markup used to be about snippets. Now it’s also about earning a citation in Google AI Mode, ChatGPT, and Perplexity.

AI Schema Gen is built for this shift:

  • Entity-Aware JSON-LD — every schema block describes your business, author, or content as a connected entity, not an isolated snippet
  • sameAs Links — connect your site to authoritative profiles (Wikipedia, Wikidata, LinkedIn, Crunchbase, social profiles) that AI models use to verify who you are
  • Entity @graph Output — every entity on the page linked by canonical @id references, the exact structure Google and AI crawlers use to resolve identity
  • Knowledge Graph Entity Score — a 0–100 score tracking how completely your site’s core entity (Organization or LocalBusiness) is defined, so you can see — and close — your entity gaps

Rich Results Too

Schema markup (structured data) also helps traditional search engines understand your content. When implemented correctly, it enables rich results in Google such as:

  • Star ratings and review snippets
  • Product prices and availability
  • FAQ accordions directly in search results
  • Recipe cards with cook time and calories
  • Event dates and locations
  • Breadcrumb navigation trails

AI Schema Gen generates all of these automatically — no JSON-LD knowledge required.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate AI Schema Gen
  2. Create a free account at aischemagen.com and copy your API key
  3. Paste the API key into the plugin settings
  4. Open any post or page in the WordPress editor
  5. Click Generate with AI from the AI Schema Gen meta box or admin bar on the top
  6. Schema markup is generated, validated, and saved automatically

See the full getting started guide for detailed instructions.

Why AI Schema Gen?

  • 30 seconds to generate complete schema markup instead of 10+ minutes manually
  • AI-powered content analysis — detects the right schema type automatically
  • 827+ schema types — Article, Product, LocalBusiness, FAQ, Recipe, Event, and every type on schema.org
  • Smart page detection — automatically identifies your page type and selects the correct schema without any manual input
  • Site type awareness — 23 site types (local business, SaaS, news, podcast, portfolio, and more) ensure schema output fits your kind of website
  • Entity @graph output — all entities output in a single @graph block with canonical @id cross-references, the format Google recommends
  • Built-in validation — checks against schema.org specifications and Google’s Rich Results requirements
  • Google Rich Results Test integration — one-click validation inside WordPress
  • Universal — works with any theme, page builder, and content type

Free Features

  • Entity @graph Output — all schema entities are output in a single @graph block with canonical @id cross-references, matching Google’s recommended structured data format
  • Knowledge Graph Entity Score — tracks how completely your site’s core entity (Organization or LocalBusiness) is defined, helping improve Google Knowledge Graph eligibility
  • 30 AI Generations per Month — Let AI analyze your content and generate schema automatically
  • All 827+ Schema Types — Article, Product, Recipe, FAQ, HowTo, Event, LocalBusiness, Service, Organization, Person, Course, VideoObject, ImageObject, Breadcrumb, Review, and more
  • Smart Page Type Detection — automatically classifies each page (homepage, service, FAQ, product, recipe, event, and 12 more types) and selects the correct schema types to generate
  • Schema Decision Engine — a built-in decision matrix maps your site type and page type to the right schema combination every time, no guesswork required
  • Site Type Configuration — 23 site types across local/physical and online/digital categories (restaurant, law firm, SaaS, news, podcast, portfolio, and more) tailor schema output to your business
  • Business Subtype — maps your business to a specific schema.org subtype (Plumber, Dentist, Attorney, Restaurant, etc.) for more precise rich result eligibility
  • FAQ Auto-Detection — automatically detects FAQ content from Gutenberg blocks, Elementor accordions, and standard HTML <details> elements
  • Auto-Apply on Publish — automatically generates schema when you publish or update posts, configurable per post type
  • Rule Engine — assign schema types automatically by post type, category, tag, or URL pattern without spending AI credits
  • Schema Health Score — per-post 0–100 quality score based on validation results, entity signals, images, and field completeness
  • Visual Editor — Edit schema fields with a user-friendly visual interface
  • Code Editor — Full JSON-LD code editing for advanced users
  • Built-in Validation — Ensure your schema is valid before publishing
  • Google Rich Results Test Integration — One-click test against Google’s validator
  • Single Site — Fully functional on a single WordPress installation

Pro Plan ($9.99/mo) — For Your Own Website

  • 300 AI Generations per Month
  • Bulk Generation — Generate or update schemas for 100+ posts at once
  • 100 Competitor URL Analyses per Month — Analyze competitor schemas for gap insights
  • Content Gap Analysis — See which schema types your competitors use that you don’t
  • Google Search Console Integration — Import real click and impression data
  • All free features included

Premium Plan ($29/mo) — For Client Work & Agencies

  • 1,000 AI Generations per Month
  • Unlimited Competitor URL Analyses
  • Multi-Site Support — Connect up to 5 WordPress sites (+$5/extra site)
  • Team Seats — 3 team members included (+$5/extra seat)
  • Bulk Generation — Generate or update schemas for 100+ posts at once
  • Schema Analytics Dashboard — Track rich result performance, impressions, clicks, and CTR
  • Priority Support — Email, live chat, and private Slack channel
  • All Pro features included

Supported Schema Types

  • Article / BlogPosting / NewsArticle
  • Product
  • Recipe
  • Review / AggregateRating
  • FAQ
  • HowTo
  • Event
  • LocalBusiness (and all subtypes: Restaurant, MedicalBusiness, LegalService, and 100+ more)
  • Service
  • Organization
  • Person
  • Course
  • VideoObject
  • ImageObject / ImageGallery
  • Breadcrumb
  • SoftwareApplication
  • JobPosting
  • And 800+ more from schema.org

Third-Party Integrations

  • WooCommerce — Automatic Product schema with price, availability, and ratings
  • Yoast SEO — Supported; schema output managed by AI Schema Gen to prevent duplicates
  • Rank Math — Supported; schema output managed by AI Schema Gen to prevent duplicates
  • Elementor — Schema AI Status widget for the Elementor editor
  • ACF — Custom field mapping for schema properties

📖 See the full integration guide for setup instructions.

External Services

This plugin communicates with the AI Schema Gen SaaS backend at:
https://api.aischemagen.com

No data is transmitted until an API key is entered in the plugin settings.

Schema Generation

What: Post title, content (stripped of HTML), excerpt, post type, categories, tags, headings, and featured image URL.
When: When the user clicks “Generate with AI”, saves a post with auto-apply enabled, or runs a bulk generation job.
Why: To analyse page content and generate appropriate schema.org structured data markup.

API Key Verification

What: The API key you enter in Settings.
When: When you click “Verify Key” in the Settings page.
Why: To confirm the key is valid and retrieve your plan information.

Dashboard Sync & Backup

What: Page titles, URLs, post types, the full generated schema markup (JSON-LD) for each page, validation status, your entity/organization settings, and your plugin configuration (site type, business subtype, automation settings). Your API key is never included in this data.
When: Automatically after any schema is generated, edited, or deleted; every 6 hours via WordPress cron; or when you click “Sync Now” in Settings.
Why: To power your AI Schema Gen dashboard (coverage, validation, and analytics views), and to back up your settings and generated schema so they can be restored automatically if you reconnect an API key on a fresh WordPress install — for example, after uninstalling and reinstalling the plugin, which deletes all local plugin data and database tables.

Service Provider

AI Schema Gen is operated by Digital Storks Ltd.

Terms of Service: https://aischemagen.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://aischemagen.com/privacy
sections.installation:
From the WordPress Plugin Directory

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for AI Schema Gen
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Go to AI Schema Gen in the admin sidebar
  5. Create a free account at aischemagen.com to get your API key
  6. Paste your API key in the Settings page

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip from wordpress.org/plugins/ai-schema-gen
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the zip and activate

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • MySQL 5.7 or higher / MariaDB 10.3 or higher

📖 Full installation guide: aischemagen.com/docs#installation
sections.faq:
What is schema markup?

Schema markup (structured data) is code added to your website that helps search engines understand your content. It can result in rich snippets in search results, such as star ratings, prices, FAQ accordions, recipe cards, event details, and more.

Do I need an API key?

Yes. Create a free account at aischemagen.com — it takes 30 seconds. The free account gives you 30 AI generations per month at no cost. Copy your API key and paste it into the plugin Settings page.

Will this slow down my site?

No. AI Schema Gen outputs lightweight JSON-LD in the page <head>. The admin interface uses React but is only loaded in the WordPress dashboard — it is never loaded on your front end.

Is the generated schema valid?

AI Schema Gen includes built-in validation that checks your markup against schema.org specifications and Google’s Rich Results requirements. You can also test with Google’s Rich Results Test in one click directly inside the plugin.

Does it work with Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

Yes. AI Schema Gen suppresses competing schema output from Yoast SEO and Rank Math to prevent duplicate structured data. Your existing Yoast/Rank Math settings are untouched — only the schema output is managed by AI Schema Gen.

Can I use it on multiple sites?

The Pro plan supports 1 site. The Premium plan supports 5 sites, with additional sites available at +$5/site. Each WordPress site needs its own API key.

What AI models are used?

AI Schema Gen uses state-of-the-art AI models to analyze your content and generate schema markup. Your content is never used for AI model training.

What happens if I exceed my monthly limit?

You can still manually create and edit schemas using the visual editor or code editor. Only AI-powered generation counts toward the monthly limit. Upgrade your plan at any time from aischemagen.com/billing.

Where can I find detailed documentation?

Full documentation including installation guides, feature walkthroughs, schema type references, and troubleshooting is available at aischemagen.com/docs.

Where do I report bugs or request features?

Use the WordPress.org support forum for public issues, or email support@aischemagen.com for account-related questions.
